migration_name: Clinical record provenance and reference terminology foundation
description: Create schema-only immutable source-record revision provenance and governed flat-reference terminology tables without importing package records or enabling runtime features.

check_constraints.name: chk_clinical_record_revision_key_profile
check_constraints.expression: source_key_canonicalization = 'rfc8785-jcs-v1'

check_constraints.name: chk_clinical_record_revision_record_profile
check_constraints.expression: source_record_canonicalization = 'rfc8785-jcs-v1'

check_constraints.name: chk_clinical_record_revision_sha256
check_constraints.expression: source_key_sha256 REGEXP '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND source_record_sha256 REGEXP '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'

check_constraints.name: chk_clinical_record_revision_number
check_constraints.expression: revision_number >= 1

check_constraints.name: chk_clinical_record_revision_source_key
check_constraints.expression: source_key_canonical <> '' AND OCTET_LENGTH(source_key_canonical) = OCTET_LENGTH(TRIM(source_key_canonical)) AND JSON_VALID(source_key_canonical) AND JSON_TYPE(source_key_canonical) = 'OBJECT'

check_constraints.name: chk_clinical_record_revision_seen_at
check_constraints.expression: last_seen_at >= first_seen_at

check_constraints.name: chk_clinical_reference_term_type_keys
check_constraints.expression: term_type_key REGEXP '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$' AND domain_key REGEXP '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$' AND entity_key REGEXP '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$'

check_constraints.name: chk_clinical_reference_term_type_status
check_constraints.expression: governance_status IN ('draft','in_review','approved','rejected','retired')

check_constraints.name: chk_clinical_reference_term_type_booleans
check_constraints.expression: runtime_reference_enabled IN (0,1) AND runtime_selection_enabled IN (0,1)

check_constraints.name: chk_clinical_reference_term_type_selection
check_constraints.expression: runtime_selection_enabled = 0 OR runtime_reference_enabled = 1

check_constraints.name: chk_clinical_reference_term_type_runtime
check_constraints.expression: runtime_reference_enabled = 0 AND runtime_selection_enabled = 0 OR governance_status = 'approved'

check_constraints.name: chk_clinical_reference_term_type_retired
check_constraints.expression: governance_status <> 'retired' OR runtime_reference_enabled = 0 AND runtime_selection_enabled = 0

check_constraints.name: chk_clinical_reference_term_type_decision
check_constraints.expression: governance_status NOT IN ('approved','rejected','retired') OR decision_actor IS NOT NULL AND OCTET_LENGTH(decision_actor) > 0 AND OCTET_LENGTH(decision_actor) = OCTET_LENGTH(TRIM(decision_actor)) AND decided_at IS NOT NULL

check_constraints.name: chk_clinical_reference_term_type_actor
check_constraints.expression: decision_actor IS NULL OR OCTET_LENGTH(decision_actor) > 0 AND OCTET_LENGTH(decision_actor) = OCTET_LENGTH(TRIM(decision_actor))

check_constraints.name: chk_clinical_reference_term_type_reason
check_constraints.expression: decision_reason IS NULL OR OCTET_LENGTH(decision_reason) > 0 AND OCTET_LENGTH(decision_reason) = OCTET_LENGTH(TRIM(decision_reason))

check_constraints.name: chk_clinical_reference_term_values
check_constraints.expression: term_code <> '' AND OCTET_LENGTH(term_code) = OCTET_LENGTH(TRIM(term_code)) AND !(term_code REGEXP '[[:cntrl:]]') AND preferred_label <> '' AND OCTET_LENGTH(preferred_label) = OCTET_LENGTH(TRIM(preferred_label)) AND !(preferred_label REGEXP '[[:cntrl:]]')

check_constraints.name: chk_clinical_reference_term_status
check_constraints.expression: governance_status IN ('draft','in_review','approved','rejected','retired')

check_constraints.name: chk_clinical_reference_term_booleans
check_constraints.expression: runtime_reference_enabled IN (0,1) AND runtime_selection_enabled IN (0,1) AND is_current IN (0,1)

check_constraints.name: chk_clinical_reference_term_selection
check_constraints.expression: runtime_selection_enabled = 0 OR runtime_reference_enabled = 1

check_constraints.name: chk_clinical_reference_term_runtime
check_constraints.expression: runtime_reference_enabled = 0 OR governance_status = 'approved' AND is_current = 1 AND retired_at IS NULL

check_constraints.name: chk_clinical_reference_term_effective_dates
check_constraints.expression: effective_to IS NULL OR effective_from IS NULL OR effective_to >= effective_from

check_constraints.name: chk_clinical_reference_term_retired_at
check_constraints.expression: retired_at IS NULL OR is_current = 0 AND runtime_reference_enabled = 0 AND runtime_selection_enabled = 0

check_constraints.name: chk_clinical_reference_term_retired_status
check_constraints.expression: governance_status <> 'retired' OR is_current = 0 AND retired_at IS NOT NULL AND runtime_reference_enabled = 0 AND runtime_selection_enabled = 0

check_constraints.name: chk_clinical_reference_term_replacement_state
check_constraints.expression: replacement_term_id IS NULL OR is_current = 0

check_constraints.name: chk_clinical_reference_term_decision
check_constraints.expression: governance_status NOT IN ('approved','rejected','retired') OR decision_actor IS NOT NULL AND OCTET_LENGTH(decision_actor) > 0 AND OCTET_LENGTH(decision_actor) = OCTET_LENGTH(TRIM(decision_actor)) AND decided_at IS NOT NULL

check_constraints.name: chk_clinical_reference_term_actor
check_constraints.expression: decision_actor IS NULL OR OCTET_LENGTH(decision_actor) > 0 AND OCTET_LENGTH(decision_actor) = OCTET_LENGTH(TRIM(decision_actor))

check_constraints.name: chk_clinical_reference_term_reason
check_constraints.expression: decision_reason IS NULL OR OCTET_LENGTH(decision_reason) > 0 AND OCTET_LENGTH(decision_reason) = OCTET_LENGTH(TRIM(decision_reason))

check_constraints.name: chk_clinical_reference_term_label_type
check_constraints.expression: label_type IN ('synonym','search_alias','abbreviation','legacy_label')

check_constraints.name: chk_clinical_reference_term_label_language
check_constraints.expression: language_code REGEXP '^[a-z]{2,3}(-[a-z0-9]{2,8})*$'

check_constraints.name: chk_clinical_reference_term_label_value
check_constraints.expression: label_value <> '' AND OCTET_LENGTH(label_value) = OCTET_LENGTH(TRIM(label_value)) AND !(label_value REGEXP '[[:cntrl:]]')

check_constraints.name: chk_clinical_reference_term_label_status
check_constraints.expression: governance_status IN ('draft','in_review','approved','rejected','retired')

check_constraints.name: chk_clinical_reference_term_label_booleans
check_constraints.expression: runtime_search_enabled IN (0,1) AND is_current IN (0,1)

check_constraints.name: chk_clinical_reference_term_label_runtime
check_constraints.expression: runtime_search_enabled = 0 OR governance_status = 'approved' AND is_current = 1 AND retired_at IS NULL

check_constraints.name: chk_clinical_reference_term_label_dates
check_constraints.expression: effective_to IS NULL OR effective_from IS NULL OR effective_to >= effective_from

check_constraints.name: chk_clinical_reference_term_label_retirement
check_constraints.expression: retired_at IS NULL OR is_current = 0 AND runtime_search_enabled = 0

check_constraints.name: chk_clinical_reference_term_label_retired_status
check_constraints.expression: governance_status <> 'retired' OR is_current = 0 AND retired_at IS NOT NULL AND runtime_search_enabled = 0

check_constraints.name: chk_clinical_reference_term_label_decision
check_constraints.expression: governance_status NOT IN ('approved','rejected','retired') OR decision_actor IS NOT NULL AND OCTET_LENGTH(decision_actor) > 0 AND OCTET_LENGTH(decision_actor) = OCTET_LENGTH(TRIM(decision_actor)) AND decided_at IS NOT NULL

check_constraints.name: chk_clinical_reference_term_label_actor
check_constraints.expression: decision_actor IS NULL OR OCTET_LENGTH(decision_actor) > 0 AND OCTET_LENGTH(decision_actor) = OCTET_LENGTH(TRIM(decision_actor))

check_constraints.name: chk_clinical_reference_term_label_reason
check_constraints.expression: decision_reason IS NULL OR OCTET_LENGTH(decision_reason) > 0 AND OCTET_LENGTH(decision_reason) = OCTET_LENGTH(TRIM(decision_reason))

columns.name: active_record_revision_id
columns.generation_expression: CASE WHEN mapping_status IN ('proposed','in_review','confirmed') THEN clinical_master_record_revision_id ELSE NULL END

check_constraints.name: chk_clinical_reference_term_source_role
check_constraints.expression: source_role IN ('primary','supporting','translation','legacy')

check_constraints.name: chk_clinical_reference_term_source_status
check_constraints.expression: mapping_status IN ('proposed','in_review','confirmed','rejected','retired')

check_constraints.name: chk_clinical_reference_term_source_decision
check_constraints.expression: mapping_status NOT IN ('confirmed','rejected','retired') OR decision_actor IS NOT NULL AND OCTET_LENGTH(decision_actor) > 0 AND OCTET_LENGTH(decision_actor) = OCTET_LENGTH(TRIM(decision_actor)) AND decided_at IS NOT NULL

check_constraints.name: chk_clinical_reference_term_source_actor
check_constraints.expression: decision_actor IS NULL OR OCTET_LENGTH(decision_actor) > 0 AND OCTET_LENGTH(decision_actor) = OCTET_LENGTH(TRIM(decision_actor))

check_constraints.name: chk_clinical_reference_term_source_reason
check_constraints.expression: decision_reason IS NULL OR OCTET_LENGTH(decision_reason) > 0 AND OCTET_LENGTH(decision_reason) = OCTET_LENGTH(TRIM(decision_reason))
